five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago spot was $4,038.3 with ATM IV at 20.47% and the put wall anchored at $3,500 — a $538 cushion below price. That cushion is gone: the wall migrated $3,500 → $3,900 on Monday, the first move in five days, and now sits at spot rather than beneath it. Net GEX in the ±20% band deepened from -16.35 Friday to -314.27 Monday, a 19x expansion of dealer short gamma; inside ±$200 of spot net GEX is -443.3 (puts -541.9 against calls +98.6), so every hedge flow in the tradeable range amplifies rather than dampens. Max pain has bled $5,400 → $5,250 (-$150) across the window while spot fell $139.4, widening the spot/max-pain gap to $1,351 and confirming that figure as a legacy-OI artifact, not a magnet. The regime changed character on Monday: the prior three sessions were low-IV drift inside a wide gamma corridor, this one is a vol-expansion break with no structural floor until $3,700.
